text:
maya: Quick question — thinking of bumping user-session-statefulset replicas 3->5 and changing rollout to a partition-based canary to avoid mass restarts. Also want to increase readinessProbe timeout from 1s -> 3s to avoid early kills. Any blockers (PVCs, cache warmup, TF wiring)?

liam: What's the trigger? traffic spike? Keep in mind new replicas mean new PVCs if using volumeClaimTemplates.

maya: Yep traffic up ~40% in EU. PVCs will be created from the template but I worry about startup I/O causing OOMs. Plan to add an initContainer to pre-warm KV cache + increase memory requests.

ekaterina: For safe rollout consider setting rollingUpdate.partition to the current highest ordinal and bump it down as we verify. Example kubectl patch: `kubectl patch sts user-session -p '{"spec":{"updateStrategy":{"rollingUpdate":{"partition":2}}}}' --type=merge`

dev-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan (workspace=prod-infra) finished — 1 resource will change: kubernetes_stateful_set.user_session

samir: Note: StatefulSet doesn't support maxSurge. Setting maxUnavailable: 0 won't apply — use partition-based strategy to limit replacements. Also prefer readinessProbe tcp/http with timeoutSeconds:3, initialDelay:10.

maya: Proposed snippet to apply to the statefulset (will mirror in TF/helm values):

```yaml
spec:
  replicas: 5
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 4
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: user-session
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "500m"
            memory: "1Gi"
          limits:
            cpu: "1"
            memory: "2Gi"
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
```

liam: LGTM. Update the TF var `session_replicas` and run `terraform plan`. I'll +1 after CI checks. Also let's add podAntiAffinity to spread across AZs.

ekaterina: Agree, add podAntiAffinity and a small sidecar for warmup logs. Also make sure KMS secret access is present in the pod's serviceAccount role — otherwise initContainer can't fetch keys.

maya: I'll add the affinity and the initContainer, update TF, and open a PR. Will tag @ekaterina and @liam for review. Plan to apply during the maintenance window. Thanks :thumbsup:
